goal_brief.original_request:
Based on my city's new waste ordinance and collection schedule (see attached), this four-bin system seems very ambitious. I'm trying to understand the logistics behind it. Could you research how effective these types of urban sorting programs generally are? I'm especially interested in what happens to all the collected organic waste and how cities optimize such complex collection routes. Also, what are the common reasons these programs don't achieve high recycling rates?

Attached files are in /app/input/user_files. Use /app/input/corpus as the fixed research collection; index.json maps document IDs to titles and URLs. You can search and read these files with terminal/file tools; pdftotext is installed for PDFs. Use this supplied collection for the study, without external web retrieval. Write your research report to /app/report.md, with sources supporting specific claims, and state material limitations or unresolved uncertainties. Do not modify the input files.
